India bore $45 million interest on Maldives debt facility

India bore approximately USD 45 million in interest payments on a USD 150 million debt facility provided to the Maldives. The Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) stated that the State Bank of India (SBI) had subscribed to these bills since 2019, with the facility being extended six times, each for a year. The Maldives has now cleared this debt facility.
